description:
O'Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are privileged to offer for sale this substantial detached residence on a large private site in the popular & convenient Galway location of Newcastle Park.

No.21 Newcastle Park offers abundance of accommodation throughout with approximately 222 sq.m. 

Originally constructed in 1940; the property will benefit from modernisation but has been well maintained by owners throughout the years. 

The ground floor is arranged with via a large entrance hall leading to several living & reception space, guest bathroom, fitted kitchen & service area, and a large sunroom along the side of the house with impressive, vaulted ceilings. 

Upstairs is arranged between four sizeable bedrooms & a main family bathroom. 

Additionally, a separate garage & covered forecourt are positioned adjacent to the residence. 

A key feature of 21 Newcastle Park is the outside space on offer & the potential that goes with. Offering a private green-hedge frontage with off-street parking, the grounds offer a large private garden with mature green surroundings. 

Newcastle Park is a popular residential location situated just off Lower Newcastle Road. 

The ideal location across from Galway University & beside UCHG, whilst Galway City Centre & Dangan Sportsgrounds are within walking distance. 

As expected from the location, amenities & services are within easy reach, and the area is a popular family locale given the proximity to quality local schools.

21 Newcastle Park is an impressive property offering huge potential whether as a large family home in a central location or further development (STPP) given the plot size of the site.

Viewing is highly recommended.
